basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old tech enthusiast based in Berlin, Germany. I've recently started delving into cloud gaming and love exploring new tech trends. Besides gaming, I'm passionate about comic book art, especially Spider-Man series, and often spend weekends visiting comic book stores. I'm currently single and work as a junior IT support specialist. I usually browse Reddit late at night, around 11 PM to 2 AM, after I get home from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology from a local university in Berlin. Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and online courses. I'm still learning about cloud computing and streaming technologies.
